items.claim: Click on a control in a linked treegrid row had its default prevented and lost focus to the row
Drag under a selected immovable ancestor carried nothing and called `onMove([])`
Disabled rows moved by Alt+arrow, and a dragged selection carried them
items.note: The pointer drag, the keyboard move and the carried selection now share one rule.
`expand` now refuses a disabled node or a held tree, as `toggle` does. Alt+Right no longer indents a row under a closed disabled branch, since the branch could not open to show it.

items.claim: Forwarded ref kept the old element after the `ul`/treegrid swap
With `onMove`, a plain click on an `href` row followed the link, and a Cmd/Ctrl/Alt click activated the row
Row tooltip kept a removed element and reopened on it
A disabled or read-only tree still drew external drop marks and answered `dropRef`
Two copies of `applyMove` in the fixtures, plus a package-path import in one
items.note: The stories and the property tests now share one implementation, and the import is relative.
